heroHeadline: Day 4,840: RM Turns 32, Teases New Music and a First Museum Exhibition
heroSubtitle: September 13, 2026 is Day 4,840 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. RM celebrated his 32nd birthday on Sept 12 with a low-key gathering with bandmates, telling fans in an online stream he's 'about to start writing music again' now that the ARIRANG era's North American leg has wrapped. The same day, Soompi confirmed BTS topped September's boy-group brand reputation rankings for the sixth-straight month (6.63M index, 93.91% positive sentiment) and also led the advertisement-model rankings, while coverage detailed 'RM x SFMOMA: Between You and Me' — the first museum exhibition of RM's personal art collection, pairing roughly 200 works from his and SFMOMA's holdings, opening Oct 3, 2026 with RM as lead curator. The ARIRANG World Tour resumes Oct 2 in Bogotá, Colombia, opening its Latin American leg.
